hook: Gerald aggressively accuses Juliana's husband of theft, immediately drawing an armed constable into a tense confrontation at their doorstep.
cliffhanger: Alexander calmly tells the constable to search the cottage, leaving Juliana in panicked confusion as they prepare to let the authorities in.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the core conflict: an arrogant aristocrat is using an armed official to harass and threaten an exiled couple.
narrative_context: Gerald confronts Juliana and Alexander at their cottage with a false accusation of theft, forcing them to submit to a search.
promotional_strength: High tension and clear antagonism between the characters create immediate dramatic stakes that pull the viewer into the conflict.

evidence.observation: Gerald accuses Alexander of stealing his gold pocket watch.
Alexander calmly tells the constable to search the cottage.

logline: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Aggressive, Snarl)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Incredulous, Gasping)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: What? When?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Cold, Certain)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: The last time I came here.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Contemptuous, Outraged)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: You never even entered the cottage!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Smug, Threatening)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Adamant, Protective)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander would never steal from you.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Mocking, Spiteful)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Choose your next words carefully.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Shouting, Dramatic)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

source_segments.label: CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern)
source_segments.speaker: CONSTABLE
source_segments.text: I have received a complaint of theft.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: A complaint is not proof.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

source_segments.label: CONSTABLE (Cold, Procedural)
source_segments.speaker: CONSTABLE
source_segments.text: Then a search will settle the matter.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Taunting)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: If he has nothing to hide...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.

source_segments.label: GERALD (O.S.) (Smug)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: ...let the constable search.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Grated)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Search it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resigned, Calm)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Let them.

hook: The constable searches Alexander's coat pocket and pulls out a gleaming gold watch, setting off an immediate wave of shock.
cliffhanger: The scene ends on a devastating freeze-frame of the dangling pocket watch while Gerald grins in triumphant gloating.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can understand the setup of a malicious frame-up and the immediate emotional devastation it causes.
narrative_context: The search of the cottage yields the planted stolen watch inside Alexander's coat, fulfilling Gerald's trap.
promotional_strength: Delivers a powerful moment of betrayal and cliffhanger tension that makes viewers want to see how the characters will escape the trap.

evidence.observation: The constable finds the gold pocket watch inside Alexander's inner coat pocket.
The episode ends with a freeze-frame of the watch dangling as Gerald gloats.

logline: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Pained, Selfless)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: But one blow would destroy her life.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Startled, Shouting)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: That is his coat!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Gloating, Victorious)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: There it is. Ha!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.
